issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters (and Part 2 describes messageOnRide() returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"), and the template's commented Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. The solution repository, however, defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements messageOnRide(String) in Pig and Seal. This parameter mismatch is structural and will confuse students and/or cause tests to fail because the interface signature in the solution does not match the specification and the template usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Rideable interface and all implementations with the problem specification: change Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) to messageOnRide() with no parameters, and update Pig and Seal to implement messageOnRide() returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement, UML, and template Main usages to document and use the parameter consistently.

issues.description: The method signature for the 'ride' action is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template expect a parameterless messageOnRide() (used in the template Main.java), but the solution implements Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and the implementing classes Pig and Seal define messageOnRide(String equipment). This mismatch between a parameterless method and a method taking a String creates confusion for students mapping the requirement to the code and may prevent a straightforward implementation that matches the exercise description.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the ride method signature across all artifacts. Change the solution to declare Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to implement messageOnRide() returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (e.g., "Riding on Pig Doodle"). Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is required pedagogically, update the problem statement and template to require and use messageOnRide(String equipment) consistently.
